What do tile match boosters do?

They help when a board gets tough. In Trip Sort, Hint lights up your best move, Undo puts your last tile back, Shuffle mixes the tiles left on the board, the Magic Wand clears a whole set and the Extra Slot adds a fifth slot to the tray.
Which booster is the most useful?
It depends on the problem. Undo fixes a mistake you just made, Shuffle helps when the board is stuck, and the Magic Wand or Extra Slot help most when the tray is nearly full.
How do I get more boosters in Trip Sort?
You start with some of each and can buy more with coins. Optional rewarded videos give extra hints, and daily rewards, daily missions and the Daily Challenge are part of everyday play.
